jobs.title: Account Manager, Strategic Accounts - Meta
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

The Account Manager, Strategic Accounts - Meta plays a critical role in expanding and strengthening Ciena's partnership with Meta, one of the company's most strategic global customers. This individual will combine sales expertise, customer engagement, business acumen, and operational excellence to help drive growth across Ciena's portfolio of networking solutions.

Working as a member of the Global Cloud Networking (GCN) Sales organization, the successful candidate will support the development and execution of account strategies that accelerate bookings, revenue growth, profitability, and market share while delivering exceptional customer experience. The role requires close collaboration with customer stakeholders, partners, and internal cross-functional teams to ensure Ciena remains a trusted advisor and strategic technology partner to Meta.

Success in this role demands a strong customer-first mindset, executive presence, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex technical and commercial environments.

**How You Will Contribute**

* Serve as a key member of the Meta account team, reporting to the Senior Director, Strategic Accounts - Meta, and partnering closely with other sales team members to execute the overall account strategy
* Develop and maintain trusted relationships with stakeholders across Meta's engineering, supply chain, operations, and leadership organizations
* Support the development and execution of comprehensive account plans that drive bookings, revenue growth, profitability, and long-term customer success
* Identify, develop, and advance opportunities across core, metro, edge, data center interconnect, inside the data center, and submarine networking applications
* Maintain a deep understanding of Meta's business priorities, network evolution, technology roadmap, and investment strategies
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional engagement across Sales Engineering, Product Line Management, Services, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations to achieve customer and business objectives.
* Monitor and analyze competitive activity within the account and develop strategies to defend or expand Ciena’s market share
* Secure accurate forecasts and maintain high-quality pipeline visibility and opportunity tracking within Salesforce
* Support commercial execution activities, including pricing, quotations, lead-time communication, contract support, and purchase order management
* Partner with Operations and Supply Chain teams to proactively manage fulfillment, delivery expectations, and customer communications, ensuring alignment between Meta’s expectations and Ciena’s delivery capabilities
* Deliver executive-level account reviews, business updates, and strategic insights to internal leadership and stakeholders
* Synthesize and analyze data from multiple sources to support business planning, customer engagement, and strategic decision-making
* Coordinate customer meetings, workshops, executive briefings, and social events

**Must Haves**

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
* 5+ years of experience in optical networking, cloud infrastructure, or related technology sales or sales engineering
* Proven record of achieving or exceeding sales, business development, or account growth objectives
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer relationships and influence decision-making across multiple organizational levels
* Strong business, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate customer requirements into actionable strategies
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical, operational, and executive audiences
* Initiative-taking self-starter with the ability to prioritize, organize, and execute effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with proven ability to build support across matrixed organizations
* Proficiency with CRM tools, forecasting processes, and opportunity management disciplines
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed

**Nice to Haves**

* Experience working with hyperscale cloud providers, internet content providers, or large-scale data center operators
* Direct experience managing strategic accounts with complex, multi-year technology investment cycles
* Deep understanding of optical networking, packet networking, routing, data center interconnect, and submarine network infrastructure
* Experience selling through both direct and partner-channel models
* Knowledge of Meta's networking environment, technology architecture, and procurement processes
* Experience supporting large-scale global accounts with substantial revenue responsibility
* Salesforce proficiency
* MBA or advanced technical degree

**Pay Range**

The annual total target compensation range for this position, in California, is $202,600.00 - $323,600.00 USD.

This includes both base salary and incentive compensation and may vary based on skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Delinea:**  
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

**Strategic Account Manager Summary:**

This remote position requires a motivated self-starter who will be responsible for all net new sales into Strategic Accounts, $20 Billion and above as defined by Delinea based on annual revenue. These represent Delinea’s most strategic and sophisticated client relationships.

Covering a specific accounts list rather than a geographic region, the candidate may be required to travel up to 50% to visit customers, attend field events, and for internal meetings such as sales kick-offs or quarterly business reviews.

**What You'll Do:**

* Apply strong business acumen and Delinea sales methodology to every prospective customer engagement
* Achieve/exceed quota targets, while developing satisfied and referenceable customers
* Effectively prospect to uncover sales opportunities within assigned territory
* Lead complex sales-cycles and effectively present the value of our applications to C-level executives of organizations
* Build and maintain relationships with influencers and decision-makers
* Quickly understand business challenges and create solutions.
* Manage sales pipeline and ensure CRM accuracy
* Learn how solutions meet needs of clients and develop skill solution focused selling
* Work with marketing and sales teams to develop target strategies
* Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profits
* Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives
* Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders
* Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement to meet sales quotas
* Forecast and track key account metrics (e.g. quarterly sales results and annual forecasts)
* Collaborate with sales teams to identify and grow opportunities within territory

**What You'll Bring:**

* 10+ years of experience successfully selling ROI-driven, Enterprise-Wide SaaS/Subscription/Cloud Applications to C-level decision makers within $20bn+ organizations.
* Experience selling Professional Services as part of outcome-based solution selling
* Ability to demonstrate software offerings at a detailed level, develop innovative value propositions to maximize sales revenue, and negotiate and close under time and objective pressure
* Demonstrated success in working with the channel partner and alliance ecosystem
* Proven track record as an avid hunter, with experience closing complex sales cycles in a consultative manner, who consistently exceeds quota
* Thrill of generating and executing strategic plans for closing new logos and growing key accounts
* Flexibility and ability to thrive selling as an individual, while effectively communicating the technical and business value of Delinea solutions to all prospect stakeholders in prospect base
* Proficiency with sales automation applications and technologies, particularly SFDC forecasting and reporting
* Familiarity with sales process frameworks, specifically MEDDPICC
* Understand and leverage organization structure and dynamics to support the strategy, culture, and priorities of the company
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills
* Ability to travel up to 50%

**Bonus if You Have:**

* Experience in cybersecurity industry
* Privileged Access Management or Identity Access Management experience
* Bachelor's Degree

**Why work at Delinea?**

* We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.
* We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.
* What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

**At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:**

* Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do
* Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments
* Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team
* Ownership - We take initiative and follow through
* Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment
* Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

**Front Desk / Guest Services & Spa Operations Associate**

Piedmont Springs | Oakland, CA  
Part-Time | Flexible Day, Swing & Evening Shifts | Broad Weekly Availability Required

Piedmont Springs is looking for a friendly, dependable, energetic person to join our Guest Services team.

**First, an important note: this is not a sedentary receptionist position.**

Although every member of our Guest Services team works at the front desk, this is an **active, hands-on position**. Our staff rotate between front-desk responsibilities and helping operate the spa throughout the shift.

On any given shift, you may be checking in guests and answering phones one moment, then walking through the facility to reset spa rooms, handle towels and laundry, check restrooms and common areas, restock supplies, or assist with other operational needs the next.

**If you're looking for a job where you'll spend most of your shift sitting behind a desk, this probably isn't the right position for you.**

On the other hand, if you enjoy staying busy, moving around, helping customers, working independently, and having different things to do throughout your shift, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

Our Guest Services staff are responsible for helping provide a welcoming experience for our customers while keeping the spa operating smoothly. Responsibilities include:

Greeting customers and providing friendly, professional service

Checking guests in and processing payments

Answering phones and booking appointments

Learning our services and helping customers select and schedule them

Maintaining accurate reservations and customer information in our scheduling system

Handling gift card purchases and redemptions

Handling cash and maintaining an accurate cash drawer

Walking first-time guests through the facility and explaining how their service works

Monitoring appointment times and helping keep spa rooms running on schedule

Resetting hot tub, sauna and steam rooms between guests

Collecting, washing, drying and folding towels and other laundry

Checking restrooms, guest areas and common areas throughout the shift and cleaning or restocking them as needed

Restocking towels, water, tea, bathroom supplies and other items

Performing routine water-chemistry checks and other basic spa-operating procedures after training

Helping identify and report facility or equipment issues

Completing routine shift procedures

Pitching in wherever needed to keep the spa clean, organized and running smoothly

These responsibilities reflect the actual mix of customer-service and operating duties at Piedmont Springs, including room turnover, laundry, cleanliness, stocking, chemical checks and general facility responsibilities.

**The Person We're Looking For**

* We're less concerned about whether you've worked at a spa before than whether you have the right approach to work.
* You'll probably enjoy this position if you:
* **Like staying busy** and prefer an active job to sitting in one place all day
* Naturally notice when something needs to be done and take care of it
* Are friendly and comfortable interacting with many different types of people
* Can remain calm and organized when several things need attention at once
* Take pride in keeping your workplace clean and presentable
* Are comfortable cleaning guest areas and restrooms when necessary
* Don't mind handling towels, doing laundry or performing other hands-on tasks
* Are dependable and understand that your coworkers are counting on you to show up for scheduled shifts
* Can follow detailed procedures while also using good judgment
* Are comfortable working independently without needing constant direction
* Pay attention to details, particularly when handling reservations, payments and customer requests
* Are willing to learn and accept feedback
* Have a genuine "pitch in and help" attitude

Previous customer-service, hospitality, retail, restaurant, spa or similar experience is helpful, but **attitude, reliability and work ethic matter more to us than having a particular background.**

Schedule — Please Read Before Applying

We are currently hiring for a flexible member of our Front Desk / Guest Services team who can work across more than one of our regular shift schedules.

Our typical Front Desk shifts are:

Day: approximately 10:00 AM–4:00 PM  
Swing: approximately 12:00 PM–7:00 PM  
Night: approximately 4:00 PM–11:00 PM

This position is intended for someone with broad, ongoing availability who can regularly work a combination of these shift types rather than being limited exclusively to mornings, afternoons or evenings.

We are looking for approximately 3–4 shifts per week, depending on scheduling needs and the employee's availability.

Applicants should have recurring availability across at least five days of the week, with the ability to work across multiple shift types. Weekend availability is strongly preferred and will be considered as part of the overall schedule fit.

Please apply only if the availability you provide reflects a schedule you can reliably maintain on an ongoing basis. Specific shifts and hours may vary based on business needs and are not guaranteed.

**Physical & Work Environment**

This is an active position. Team members spend significant portions of their shifts **standing and walking throughout the facility**, including moving between floors and different areas of the spa.

The job also involves routine activities such as handling laundry and towels, bending and reaching while resetting or stocking areas, and working around the warm and humid environment associated with hot tubs, saunas and steam rooms.

jobs.title: Study Operations Coordinator (Volunteer)
jobs.description:
**LunaVax Institute Nigeria**
-----------------------------

Skip ahead to take the next step and apply

### **Study Operations Coordinator (Volunteer)**

**Type**: Volunteer, Part-Time
  
**Location**: Remote (Nigeria-based preferred; applicants elsewhere are welcome)

**About LunaVax Institute Nigeria**
  
LunaVax Institute Nigeria is a research and implementation organization advancing vaccine access through research, innovation and implementation science. We focus on addressing measles and rubella immunization gaps, particularly among zero-dose children and communities that are difficult to reach, while generating evidence to inform the adoption of new vaccine delivery tools in Nigeria.

**Our Current Work**
  
We are preparing a Phase III effectiveness-implementation study comparing a needle-free measles-rubella microarray patch with standard injection in infants and toddlers across four Nigerian states, including facility and outreach settings. A preparatory pilot is planned before the main study.

Preparing a multi-state study involves many moving parts: protocol development with volunteer advisors, site identification and readiness assessments, stakeholder engagement, regulatory and ethics preparation, and evaluation of the digital and biometric tools that will support data collection. Our team includes volunteers, advisors and partner organizations across Nigeria and beyond.

**The Role**
  
We are seeking a Study Operations Coordinator to help keep our study preparation organized, on schedule and well documented. Working closely with the Founder & Director, you will coordinate tasks across workstreams, track deliverables and deadlines, and support the operational planning needed to move from protocol development to study start-up.

This is an opportunity to gain practical experience in clinical study coordination and operations, from early planning and site readiness to regulatory preparation and team coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate study preparation activities across workstreams, tracking tasks, owners, deadlines and progress
* Maintain project trackers, action logs and decision records, and follow up with team members on outstanding items
* Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, take notes and circulate action points
* Support site identification and readiness activities with implementation partners, including facility screening and readiness assessments
* Help draft and organize study documents, including standard operating procedures, checklists and operational plans
* Support preparation of ethics and regulatory submission materials, including tracking required documents and timelines
* Coordinate team preparation for technology partner demonstrations, including tracking training and collecting questions
* Maintain organized, version-controlled study files on SharePoint
* Support onboarding of new volunteers and help them settle into their workstreams
* Flag risks, delays and resource gaps early, and propose practical solutions

**Requirements**

* A degree in public health, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, life sciences or a related field (completed or in progress, including postgraduate students)
* Experience in project coordination, clinical research, public health programs or a similar operational role
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication, including following up with colleagues professionally
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Word and Excel
* Reliability and accountability in completing agreed tasks
* Ability to commit around 5 to 8 hours per week for at least six months
* Commitment to confidentiality and responsible handling of study information

**Desirable Experience**

* Clinical trial coordination or research site experience
* Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training or certification
* Familiarity with ethics committee (HREC or NHREC) or NAFDAC submission processes
* Experience with immunization programs, primary health care or community health in Nigeria
* Experience coordinating volunteers, multi-site projects or remote teams
* Familiarity with digital data collection tools such as CommCare or ODK
* Knowledge of the Nigerian health system

**What You’ll Gain**

* Hands-on experience coordinating preparation for a planned Phase III vaccine study
* Exposure to protocol development, site readiness, regulatory preparation and technology evaluation
* Direct mentorship from the Founder & Director and opportunities to learn from advisors in clinical research, regulatory science and implementation science
* Collaboration with colleagues and partners across research, implementation and global health
* A portfolio of study coordination and operations work
* A certificate of service and a letter of recommendation on successful completion of your commitment
* A flexible, fully remote role that fits around study or other work commitments

**Engagement**
  
This is a volunteer role. The time commitment is around 5 to 8 hours per week, used flexibly, for a minimum of six months. It is fully remote, with meetings scheduled in advance, and you will sign a confidentiality agreement before starting. No participant data will be collected until ethics and regulatory approvals are in place. As funding is secured, we intend to develop paid roles and will consider contributors to our work, although we cannot guarantee this.

LunaVax Institute Nigeria is an equal opportunity organization. We value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all team members.

**Front Desk / Guest Services & Spa Operations Associate**

Piedmont Springs | Oakland, CA  
Part-Time | Flexible Day, Swing & Evening Shifts | Broad Weekly Availability Required

Piedmont Springs is looking for a friendly, dependable, energetic person to join our Guest Services team.

**First, an important note: this is not a sedentary receptionist position.**

Although every member of our Guest Services team works at the front desk, this is an **active, hands-on position**. Our staff rotate between front-desk responsibilities and helping operate the spa throughout the shift.

On any given shift, you may be checking in guests and answering phones one moment, then walking through the facility to reset spa rooms, handle towels and laundry, check restrooms and common areas, restock supplies, or assist with other operational needs the next.

**If you're looking for a job where you'll spend most of your shift sitting behind a desk, this probably isn't the right position for you.**

On the other hand, if you enjoy staying busy, moving around, helping customers, working independently, and having different things to do throughout your shift, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

Our Guest Services staff are responsible for helping provide a welcoming experience for our customers while keeping the spa operating smoothly. Responsibilities include:

Greeting customers and providing friendly, professional service

Checking guests in and processing payments

Answering phones and booking appointments

Learning our services and helping customers select and schedule them

Maintaining accurate reservations and customer information in our scheduling system

Handling gift card purchases and redemptions

Handling cash and maintaining an accurate cash drawer

Walking first-time guests through the facility and explaining how their service works

Monitoring appointment times and helping keep spa rooms running on schedule

Resetting hot tub, sauna and steam rooms between guests

Collecting, washing, drying and folding towels and other laundry

Checking restrooms, guest areas and common areas throughout the shift and cleaning or restocking them as needed

Restocking towels, water, tea, bathroom supplies and other items

Performing routine water-chemistry checks and other basic spa-operating procedures after training

Helping identify and report facility or equipment issues

Completing routine shift procedures

Pitching in wherever needed to keep the spa clean, organized and running smoothly

These responsibilities reflect the actual mix of customer-service and operating duties at Piedmont Springs, including room turnover, laundry, cleanliness, stocking, chemical checks and general facility responsibilities.

**The Person We're Looking For**

* We're less concerned about whether you've worked at a spa before than whether you have the right approach to work.
* You'll probably enjoy this position if you:
* **Like staying busy** and prefer an active job to sitting in one place all day
* Naturally notice when something needs to be done and take care of it
* Are friendly and comfortable interacting with many different types of people
* Can remain calm and organized when several things need attention at once
* Take pride in keeping your workplace clean and presentable
* Are comfortable cleaning guest areas and restrooms when necessary
* Don't mind handling towels, doing laundry or performing other hands-on tasks
* Are dependable and understand that your coworkers are counting on you to show up for scheduled shifts
* Can follow detailed procedures while also using good judgment
* Are comfortable working independently without needing constant direction
* Pay attention to details, particularly when handling reservations, payments and customer requests
* Are willing to learn and accept feedback
* Have a genuine "pitch in and help" attitude

Previous customer-service, hospitality, retail, restaurant, spa or similar experience is helpful, but **attitude, reliability and work ethic matter more to us than having a particular background.**

Schedule — Please Read Before Applying

We are currently hiring for a flexible member of our Front Desk / Guest Services team who can work across more than one of our regular shift schedules.

Our typical Front Desk shifts are:

Day: approximately 10:00 AM–4:00 PM  
Swing: approximately 12:00 PM–7:00 PM  
Night: approximately 4:00 PM–11:00 PM

This position is intended for someone with broad, ongoing availability who can regularly work a combination of these shift types rather than being limited exclusively to mornings, afternoons or evenings.

We are looking for approximately 3–4 shifts per week, depending on scheduling needs and the employee's availability.

Applicants should have recurring availability across at least five days of the week, with the ability to work across multiple shift types. Weekend availability is strongly preferred and will be considered as part of the overall schedule fit.

Please apply only if the availability you provide reflects a schedule you can reliably maintain on an ongoing basis. Specific shifts and hours may vary based on business needs and are not guaranteed.

**Physical & Work Environment**

This is an active position. Team members spend significant portions of their shifts **standing and walking throughout the facility**, including moving between floors and different areas of the spa.

The job also involves routine activities such as handling laundry and towels, bending and reaching while resetting or stocking areas, and working around the warm and humid environment associated with hot tubs, saunas and steam rooms.

At AAA, our branches are where we make good on our promises to our Members & Team Members. The Member Experience Generalist (MEG) is a pre-leadership role designed to set the standard for service and sales excellence across multiple branch locations. The Member Experience Generalist act as role model and mentors peers, demonstrating best practices in member interactions, cross-selling, and operational consistency. They encourage collaboration, and support branch culture by reinforcing AAA’s values. This role is expected to be cross-functional, mastering multiple skill blocks (e.g., DMV, concierge, insurance servicing, Smart Home, membership sales) and adapting to different branch environments. In addition, this role serve as the eyes and ears for leadership, surfacing observations and concerns to managers for action, including branch operations, individual Team Member development, and the execution of sales and marketing strategy. * Ensures compliance with AAA policies, procedures, standards, and regulations regardless of assignment.

* Provides feedback to leadership to support process improvements that enhance branch operations.
